# Klyro Works

> Klyro Works is a digital growth and technology agency specializing in bespoke website development, technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Google Ads/PPC, UI/UX design, branding, and AI workflow automation. Serving ambitious businesses across the United States, United Kingdom, and India.

## Organization & Capabilities
- **Brand Name**: Klyro Works
- **Official Website**: https://klyroworks.com
- **Target Markets**: United States (US), United Kingdom (UK), India (IN)
- **Primary Focus**: Bespoke high-performance web engineering, technical search dominance, and AI-powered operational automations
- **Core Value Proposition**: 100% intellectual property code ownership, sub-second performance standard, transparent milestone-based delivery, and strict WCAG 2.1 AA and GDPR/CCPA compliance
- **Direct Consultation Contact**: admin@klyroworks.com

## Core Services
- [Website Development](https://klyroworks.com/services/website-development): Custom, sub-second web platforms engineered with modern frameworks, zero bloatware, and accessible design.
- [Search Engine Optimisation](https://klyroworks.com/services/seo): Technical crawl optimization, Schema.org knowledge graph engineering, keyword clustering, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- [Digital Marketing & PPC](https://klyroworks.com/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven Google Ads management, Performance Max campaigns, and high-intent conversion rate optimization.
- [AI Automation & Workflows](https://klyroworks.com/services/ai-automation): Custom business process automations, automated lead qualification, and CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce).
- [UI/UX Design](https://klyroworks.com/services/ui-ux-design): User-centred product design, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes, and scalable design systems.
- [Branding & Identity](https://klyroworks.com/services/branding): Distinctive brand positioning, visual identity, typography systems, and comprehensive brand guidelines.
- [Ecommerce Solutions](https://klyroworks.com/services/ecommerce): High-conversion online stores, headless Shopify development, and streamlined checkout funnels.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://klyroworks.com/services/social-media-marketing): Commercial paid and organic social strategies driving brand authority.
- [Content Marketing](https://klyroworks.com/services/content-marketing): Authority-building topic clusters and conversion copywriting aligned with E-E-A-T guidelines.

## Industry Solutions
- [Real Estate](https://klyroworks.com/industries/real-estate): Property portals, MLS/IDX integrations, local SEO, and automated valuation booking funnels.
- [Dental Clinics](https://klyroworks.com/industries/dental-clinics): Healthcare websites, patient acquisition funnels, local Google 3-Pack SEO, and appointment automations.
- [Ecommerce DTC](https://klyroworks.com/industries/ecommerce): Scalable shopping experiences engineered for fast checkout and high customer lifetime value.
- [Professional Services](https://klyroworks.com/industries/professional-services): B2B lead generation architecture, authority positioning, and consultation scheduling for law, accounting, and consulting firms.
